build: PERSONA-LAB-TEMPLATE — which build this is: branch or patch, commit, date

defects.screen: where the defect is, in the user's terms (e.g. the form for a new item)
defects.defect: what was changed on purpose (e.g. the Save button shows an icon without a label)
defects.symptom: what a user would run into (e.g. cannot tell how to save, taps Back and loses the entry)
